title: How a Godly Man Leads a Hard Conversation Without Needing to Win It
caption:
A godly man walks into conflict first. Not to win it. To end it well.

Go first, not loud. Ask before you accuse. Speak the truth in love, both at once, and don't leave the table until you've done both.

A hard conversation done right doesn't crown anybody. It just leaves two men who can still look at each other Sunday morning.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
